text:
emma_support: Customer (acme-inc) reports promo code accepted but org balance unchanged. Code SPRINGLAUNCH2026, claimed during SSO onboarding. UI shows success + confirmation email; webhook returned 200. org_id=org_98765, billing_profile=bp-444, account=acct_222, claim_ts=2026-03-10T14:32:11Z

promo-ingest-bot: event evt_66a3 accepted -> ledger_ingest queued id=li_992, response=200

devon_billing: can you paste the webhook payload and any ledger row you have? also which endpoint the customer checked (console/org-balance or billing/invoices)?

emma_support: customer checked the console org balance and account usage page, both unchanged. copying payload: 
```json
{"event":"promo_claimed","code":"SPRINGLAUNCH2026","amount_cents":50000,"target":{"type":"billing_profile","id":"bp-444"},"org_id":"org_98765","claim_ts":"2026-03-10T14:32:11Z","webhook_status":"200"}
```

nate_sre: :eyes: notable — payload target.type is `billing_profile`. Our org-balance UI only surfaces credits with target.type='org'. Onboarding flow should default to org, not BP.

devon_billing: running quick check: `SELECT id,target_type,target_id,amount_cents,created_at FROM credits WHERE target_id='bp-444' ORDER BY created_at DESC;` -> returns row id=li_992 target_type='billing_profile' amount_cents=50000 created_at=2026-03-10T14:32:17Z

devon_billing: confirmed: credit exists but attached to billing_profile (bp-444) instead of org_98765. That explains visibility gap.

devon_billing: proposed fix: create a migration that re-parents the credit to the org ledger (create new li entry referencing original). Will also add a note for audit. ETA ~15m.

emma_support: I told the customer: "Found the grant; it landed on your billing profile (invoice) instead of the org balance. We're moving it now and will confirm when it shows up in the console."

devon_billing: applied migration patch patch_567 -> created li_993 target_type='org' target_id='org_98765' amount_cents=50000 original_ref=li_992; invoked billing-indexer to reindex.

promo-ingest-bot: ledger indexer reindexed li_993 status=ok

nate_sre: follow-up: add an internal health check for promo ingestion where onboarding routes produce target.type!='org' and add a UI flag to show BP-scoped credits. Filing ticket FN-1243.

emma_support: Customer updated: sees +$500.00 applied to org balance, confirmed. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
